```python
def test_histogram():
    # Test empty string
    assert histogram("") == {}, "Failed: empty string should return {}"

    # Test single word
    assert histogram("a") == {"a": 1}, "Failed: single word"

    # Test multiple unique words (all tie at count 1)
    assert histogram("a b c") == {"a": 1, "b": 1, "c": 1}, "Failed: all unique words"

    # Test words with tied maximum counts
    assert histogram("a b b a") == {"a": 2, "b": 2}, "Failed: tied max counts"

    # Test mixed frequencies (only max-count words kept)
    assert histogram("a b c a b") == {"a": 2, "b": 2}, "Failed: mixed frequencies"

    # Test one dominant word
    assert histogram("b b b b a") == {"b": 4}, "Failed: dominant word"

    # Test longer words
    assert histogram("apple banana apple banana cherry") == {"apple": 2, "banana": 2}, \
        "Failed: longer words with ties"

    # Verify result type
    assert isinstance(histogram("x y z"), dict), "Failed: result must be a dict"

    print("All histogram tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_histogram()
```
